'''2001 Trinoc-Con team tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG convention (team tournament) held at Trinoc-Con, Durham, NC on 6 October 2001. [[Brad Reinhold]] won it. It is known from Caleb Foth's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3045">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-10-stupid-is-as-stupid-does-at-trinocd3045/ stupid-is-as-stupid-does-at-trinoc], DeckTech (Caleb "whydoisuck" Foth, 10 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-10-stupid-is-as-stupid-does-at-trinocd3045/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 6 October 2001
* '''Site:''' Trinoc-Con, Durham, NC
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Brad Reinhold]]
